articles.headline: George Noble wins Menards 150
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
George Noble won Menards 150 at Kansas Speedway, starting P19 and leading 54 laps. Daniel Stavchanksy finished second and Samuel Riggs was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 4 cautions.

George Noble was the biggest mover, gaining 18 spots from P19 to P1.

John Verstappen leads the championship with 3143 points, 58 ahead of James Baker.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
